<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Cell''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who waits in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Arena|Cell Arena]] in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches the largest list of skills and techniques of any master and hosts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]], but he only deals with Evil-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:7-->
Cell waits in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Arena|Cell Arena]], which generates once per world in a plains biome. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 3 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Arena#Finding it|Cell Arena]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
Cell needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''40 or lower''' (Evil). Above that he still talks to you, but his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests stay locked. He only talks about his tournament to Evil-aligned players as well.
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:11-->
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Instant Transmission|Instant Transmission]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Manipulation|Ki Manipulation]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Infusion|Ki Infusion]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Protection|Ki Protection]], Defense Penetration, Healing Reduction, Ki Boost
* '''Ki attacks:''' Kamehameha, Kienzan, Galick Gun, Masenko, Death Beam, Ki Barrage
* '''Strike attacks:''' Deadly Dance, Meteor
* '''Evasion technique:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Afterimage|Afterimage]]
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:12-->
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with. Cell and [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza|Frieza]] cover a huge part of the roster on their own, which is why a Good character can't learn everything from a single master.
</translate>

<translate>
== The Cell Games == <!--T:13-->
</translate>
{{Main|Cell Games}}
<translate>
<!--T:14-->
His '''Tournament''' option opens the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]], a bracket tournament held in his arena. Its bouts are '''lethal''': losing one is a real death.
</translate>

<translate>
== As a tournament fighter == <!--T:15-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:16-->
The champion you face in the final of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]] is '''Super Perfect Cell''', an NPC fighter separate from the master who hosts the tournament. By default he has 287,000 health, 11,700 melee damage and 10,540 ki damage, and fights on the Elite AI tier.
</translate>

</gallery>
